# Error codes

<!-- Generated by infra/scripts/gen-error-codes.py (`make error-codes`). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every error response is `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}` (see conventions.md).
Clients map `code` to their own English/Tamil text via the message key.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | How to fix | Message key | Raised by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `forbidden` | 403 | Your role does not allow this action. | Ask an FPO admin to do it or to grant the needed role. | `error.forbidden` | `apps/api/agritrace/core/auth.py:76`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:382`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:502`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:740` |
| `not_found` | 404 | Not found. | Check the id or code; it may belong to another FPO. | `error.not_found` | `apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:281`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:384`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:478`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:482`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:505`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:652`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:935`<br>`apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:1019` |

| `profile_incomplete_not_allowed` | 422 | Some grading parameters have no limits yet (load_from_standard). | Enter the limits from the standard, or publish with `allow_incomplete: true` (public note shown). | `error.profile_incomplete_not_allowed` | `apps/api/agritrace/modules/quality/service.py:317` |
